title: Pete Buttigieg CRUSHES Fox News Host Talking Points in FIERY Interview
description:
In this video, Pete Buttigieg sits down for a live interview on Fox News with anchor Sandra Smith, and what starts as a routine political interview turns into one of the sharpest back and forth exchanges you will see on cable news this year. Sandra Smith does not ease into it. The very first question frames Buttigieg as a sympathizer with a set of policy positions he has never actually held, and from that moment on the interview becomes a genuine contest between two people who disagree about almost everything and are both very good at arguing.

The conversation opens on the question of where the Democratic Party actually sits right now. Sandra Smith presses on whether Buttigieg is comfortable alongside the more radical wing of his own party, referencing the Democratic Socialists of America playbook and recent Fox News polling showing that a majority of Democratic voters want dramatic or revolutionary change. Buttigieg refuses the framing entirely and pivots to the issues where he says roughly two thirds of the country already agrees, including wages, health care access, and tax policy. He revisits the Medicare for all who want it proposal he ran on, arguing that a public option without forcing anyone off their existing plan is still the right answer.

From there the interview turns to the war with Iran, and this is where it gets heated. Buttigieg argues the president made specific promises about staying out of the conflict and about how long it would last, and then did the op
